title: ＡＩロボットプログラミング
subtitle: AI Robotics Programing
educationalGoal:
(1)	Learn the basic theory of AI robotics.
(2)	Learn the Robot Operating System 2(ROS2).
(3)	Learn how to develop software for robots, including wheeled robots, robotic arms, and legged robots.
advice:
This is a unique course that provides instruction on the basics of AI robotics and robot programming from a global perspective. This course serves as a hub for theory and practice. To develop an intelligent robot, a large-scale program is needed. Thus, students will learn the ROS2 and Python language, which are used very often. Python is learned using a flipped classroom style. Students watch videos and take quizzes before class, and programming exercises are held in class.

This class will cover the following topics:
1. Development environment and ROS installation
2. ROS2 basic
3. Navigation
4. Robot vision
5. Speech Recognition and Synthesis
6. Planning
7. Manipulation
8. Programming exercises
books: Kosei Demura et al. "An introduction of AI robot programming by ROS and Python 2nd Edition," Kodansha, 2025 (in Japanese)
